name: Acuerdo de pago
trigger: A customer whose identity is already verified wants to pay, get up to date, catch up on overdue installments, or agree on a payment plan.

steps.instruction: In at most two short sentences, tell the customer the account status using only the tool result: the account's last four digits, the overdue amount and how many days late it is. Mention the total balance only if they ask. Then ask if they want you to look at the ways to get up to date, and wait for the answer.

Present at most two options from get_payment_options, with their amounts, number of installments and first due date exactly as returned, with no relative words like "mañana". One short sentence per option. Never count the options out loud: no "tienes tres opciones" or "estas dos"; start directly with the first one, for example "Puedes pagar..." and then "O también...". Offer an option marked hardship only if the customer described financial hardship such as job loss, illness or an emergency, and present it first. Then ask "¿Cuál te funciona mejor?"
Repeat out loud the chosen option's installment amount, number of installments and first due date, and ask the customer to confirm. A valid answer is a clear yes or no.

condition.condition: The customer clearly confirmed the payment plan that was just repeated to them.

steps.instruction: Use the plan_id of the option the customer confirmed, exactly as returned by get_payment_options.

steps.message: Listo. Registré tu plan y te envié el link de pago por ${channel_label}. Ahí vas a ver el valor y la fecha de tu primera cuota.

en.value: Done. I registered your plan and sent you the payment link by ${channel_label}. It shows the amount and the date of your first payment.

fallback.instruction: Tell the customer no plan was registered, and offer to review the options again or to have an advisor call them.
